title: Tool rental enquiries
bodyMd:
Each enquiry is classified once as converted or not converted to a paid rental. The table gives totals for a week, not the number of physical tools.

| Category | Enquiries | Paid rentals |
|---|---:|---:|
| Garden | 80 | 48 |
| Building | 120 | 90 |
| Cleaning | 200 | 130 |
